title: Long lines at Malolos gas stations amid major fuel price rollback

blocks.text: CITY OF MALOLOS — Motorists flocked to major gasoline stations in the city on Tuesday (Nov. 10) as fuel prices dropped by as much as P16.80 per liter. At the Petron station beside S&R Shopping Center along MacArthur Highway in Barangay San Pablo, XCS gasoline fell to P69.10 per liter from P85.90, while Premium Gasoline Xtra Advance dropped to P68.10 from P84.90 following the day’s P16.80 rollback. READ: Boon for motorists: P16.80/L price rollback for gasoline Diesel Max was priced at P86.90 per liter, while Turbo Diesel cost P89.90.
